text: 97.35% of the Newrest group's capital is held by its management; Naxicap, a shareholder for over 20 years, holds 2.65%.
short: Newrest's capital is 97.35% held by its management; Naxicap holds 2.65%.

source.name: Newrest — Our vision
source.quote: To date, 97.35% of the group’s capital is held by its management. Naxicap, which has been involved with Newrest for over 20 years, holds 2.65% of the capital.
